about: Recorded from the emulator. "show" is the digit each tube is told to show, in file order (LITHO, OCEAN, ATMOS, CRYO, CHEMO, CYCLO, ANTH, PALIN, SOLAR); "-" is blank. "lamps" is the nine marker lamps. Times are in milliseconds from the start of the recording, sampled every 10 ms. Each change lists only what changed.

sequences.what: Resting on button 1. Button 2 is pressed. Sweep up 0 to 9, fall back to 5, idle two seconds, then walk one digit a beat to the new readings.
Asleep and dark. Someone walks up. The same sequence, with a five-second idle at 5.
Button 2 is pressed, then button 3 while the sweep is still running. The sweep carries on and the walk goes to button 3's readings.
Button 2 is pressed, then button 4 during the idle at 5. No new sweep. The walk goes to button 4's readings, which are all 5, so nothing moves.
Button 2 is pressed, then button 1 partway through the walk. The whole sequence starts again from the sweep.
Resting on button 1 when a new frame arrives with three changed digits and a moved lamp. No sweep: each changed tube steps one digit a beat.
The lamp test: every tube shows 0, then 1, up to 9, a second each, then returns to its reading.
Button 3 has two tubes with no reading. They sweep and idle with the rest, then go dark at the walk.
Resting on button 2 when everyone leaves. All tubes and lamps go dark.
Asleep. Button 2 is pressed, which also wakes it.

The reset. The board fetches a frame with the lamp lit, and the next scale's file. The covered button is pressed: the board moves to scale 1, the colour comes on, and the full sequence runs to the new readings.
The covered button is pressed while its lamp is not lit. Nothing happens.
